EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES LAW, No. 5 OF 1972 READ WITH THE CO- OPERATIVESOCIETIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 32 OF 1983 AND THE CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 11 OF 1992

IN pursuance of the powers vested in me under the Section 2 (2) of the Co- operative Societies Law, No. 5 of 1972 readwith Co- operative Societies (Amendment) Act, No. 32 of 1983 and the Co - operative Societies (Amendment) Act,No. 11 of 1992, I, Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce do hereby confer on the persons appointed toassist the Commissioner of Co- operative Development and the Registrar of Co- operative Societies and specified in theColumn 1 of the Schedule hereto, from the date specified in Column II under Co- operative Societies Law, No. 5 of 1972read with Co- operative Societies (Amendment) Act, No. 32 of 1983 and the Co- operative Societies (Amendment) Act,No. 11 of 1992 and under the rules made there under, the powers specified in column III of the said schedule.
RISHAD BATHIUDEEN,Minister of Industry and Commerce.
